deal.dialogue: You look comfortable. That won't last. So let's talk about the one thing you haven't spent yet. Sign, and I'll make you stronger tonight.
Gold. You'd crawl for less, so spare me the thinking face. The coin is warm; it remembers where it was minted, and it goes home through your ribs. Haggling? Every time you ask, the price climbs.

That well gives you a sip. I'm offering the bottle. You'll pay for the glass. The thing at the end of this road will laugh at that little blade. So do I. I'll give it teeth; your skin will be thinner for it.

Wishing into a hole in the ground? Wish at me instead. I answer, and I invoice. Gold is only blood that learned manners. Pay me in the original currency, and don't faint on the carpet. Haggling? Every time you ask, the price climbs.
